seen: A chain of brown sand balls rises from the pit to the furnace, and a black carbon box appears in the third frame with a few black dots arcing toward the furnace. The sand ball stream runs in a line through the air above the ground.
problem: The sand stream floats in the air in a long column; carbon barely shows. Have the sand arc from the pit into the furnace top and make the black carbon pour clearly beside it.
text: So you pour the sand into a furnace with carbon.
